import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_raggedii_b(n)
    prefix_s_stack_1 = Vector{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_s_stack_1 = 0
    prefix_tripcount_stack_1 = Vector{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = 0
    for i_x = 1:n
        prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_s_stack_1
        prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_tripcount_stack_1
        s = 0.0
        __tot_s_stack_1 = __tot_s_stack_1 + ((div(2 - 1, 1) + 1) + 1)
        __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = __tot_tripcount_stack_1 + (div(2 - 1, 1) + 1)
    end
    tripcount_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    s_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, __tot_s_stack_1 + 1)
    return (tripcount_stack, s_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
end

function raggedii_b(out, outb, u, ub, x, xb, n, m0, tripcount_stack, s_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    s = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    for i_x = 1:n
        s = 0.0
        for i_y = 1:2
            w = m0 + i_y
            __idx_tripcount_stack_1_1 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
            tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_1] = w
            for i_j = 1:w
                s = s + x[i_j] * u[i_x]
            end
            __idx_s_stack_1_4 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
            s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_4] = s
        end
        out[i_x] = s * s
        __idx_s_stack_1_3 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (div(2 - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
        s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_3] = s
    end
    s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1] = s
    s = s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1]
    for i_x = n:-1:1
        __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (div(2 - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
        s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
        sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
        sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
        outb[i_x] = 0.0
        for i_y = 2:-1:1
            __idx_s_stack_1_0 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
            s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
            w = m0 + i_y
            __idx_tripcount_stack_1_3 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
            w = tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_3]
            for i_j = w:-1:1
                xb[i_j] = xb[i_j] + u[i_x] * sb
                ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + x[i_j] * sb
            end
        end
        sb = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_raggedii_b_cuda(n)
    prefix_s_stack_1 = CuArray{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_s_stack_1 = 0
    prefix_tripcount_stack_1 = CuArray{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = 0
    for i_x = 1:n
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_s_stack_1
                prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_tripcount_stack_1
                s = 0.0
                __tot_s_stack_1 = __tot_s_stack_1 + ((div(2 - 1, 1) + 1) + 1)
                __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = __tot_tripcount_stack_1 + (div(2 - 1, 1) + 1)
            end
    end
    tripcount_stack = CuArray{Int64}(undef, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    s_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, __tot_s_stack_1 + 1)
    return (tripcount_stack, s_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
end

function raggedii_b_cuda(out, outb, u, ub, x, xb, n, m0, tripcount_stack, s_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    s = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_raggedii_b_1!(m0, n, out, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, s_stack, tripcount_stack, u, x)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1] = s
            s = s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1]
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, cld(div(1 - n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_raggedii_b_2!(m0, n, outb, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, s_stack, tripcount_stack, u, ub, x, xb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_raggedii_b_1!(m0, n, out, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, s_stack, tripcount_stack, u, x)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s = 0.0
    for i_y = 1:2
        w = m0 + i_y
        __idx_tripcount_stack_1_1 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
        tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_1] = w
        for i_j = 1:w
            s = s + x[i_j] * u[i_x]
        end
        __idx_s_stack_1_4 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
        s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_4] = s
    end
    out[i_x] = s * s
    __idx_s_stack_1_3 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (div(2 - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
    s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_3] = s
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_raggedii_b_2!(m0, n, outb, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, s_stack, tripcount_stack, u, ub, x, xb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    sb = 0.0
    __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (div(2 - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
    s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
    sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
    sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
    outb[i_x] = 0.0
    for i_y = 2:-1:1
        __idx_s_stack_1_0 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
        s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
        w = m0 + i_y
        __idx_tripcount_stack_1_3 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + ((i_y - 1) + 1)
        w = tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_3]
        for i_j = w:-1:1
            CUDA.@atomic xb[i_j] += u[i_x] * sb
            ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + x[i_j] * sb
        end
    end
    sb = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end
